name: stat-strip
title: Stat Strip
description: A row of figures in equal sections split by dividers, each with an icon, a label and an optional change pill. Uses namespace exports: StatStrip.Root, StatStrip.Item.

docs.lead: A row of figures between a hairline above and below. Each section shows an icon, a label and its value, with an optional pill for the change against the previous period.
docs.usage:
import * as KeyIcon from "@/components/ui/key-icon"
import * as StatStrip from "@/components/ui/stat-strip"

<StatStrip.Root>
  <StatStrip.Item
    icon={<KeyIcon.Root icon={<RiTimeFill />} />}
    label="Label"
    value={3654}
  />
</StatStrip.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Stroke key icons with a tinted glyph. Number values are formatted with toLocaleString.

examples.title: Coloured icons
examples.description: Any KeyIcon style works in the icon slot, such as lighter with a colour.
examples.code:
<StatStrip.Item
  icon={<KeyIcon.Root style="lighter" color="red" icon={<RiPlayFill className="text-error-dark" />} />}
  label="Category A"
  value={15}
/>

examples.title: With delta
examples.description: Pass a pre-formatted string for currency, and a delta for a change pill. Leave delta out and the section has no pill.
examples.code:
<StatStrip.Item
  icon={<KeyIcon.Root icon={<RiMoneyDollarCircleLine />} />}
  label="Metric A"
  value="$96,000.00"
  delta={5}
/>

api.name: StatStrip.Root
api.description: The row. Its sections share the width equally.

api.name: StatStrip.Item
api.description: One section. Its icon and figure sit centred in it, and every section but the first gets a divider before it.

props.name: value
props.description: A number is formatted with toLocaleString; a string is shown as given

props.name: delta
props.description: Change against the previous period, in percent. Leave out, or pass null, for no pill

props.name: trend
props.description: Colours the pill. Pass your data source's own direction when it has one
